about_the_game:
This story is circulating in the world.

When the distant wind blew from the other side of the ocean, the mysterious East brought gorgeous satin, porcelain, and - miracles. A small number of people worshipped it as a god, but more people were afraid of it. People held up sickles and torches, avoiding it as if they saw a medieval wizard, and spurned it.

Many years later, people forgot about it, and the miracle eventually became a distant rumor and disappeared in the world.

The story takes place in the fictional Europe at the end of the 19th century. The player will play the role of a teenager working in a pet store. One day, he accidentally stepped into a mysterious toy store and discovered a strange and unusual thing. From then on, his fate began to turn - miracle? Rumor? Resurrection from the dead? The player gradually explores the truth in his contact with the three shop assistants. Maybe... things are not as simple as you see.

Deep in the foggy city, in the silent night, there is a light guiding the lost pedestrians. Love and sadness are intertwined, gradually revealing the truth about a fire five years ago. The resurrected dead, the incomplete memories, the familiar appearance, is it sin or redemption? And are they annihilated or reborn?

Follow the invisible power and explore the story in the toy store. The truth... may be even sadder.

This is a European extra chapter of the "Oriental Dreams" series. When the ancient jade from Qiyunzhou flows overseas, the mysterious oriental power will open a new chapter.
